  function quitarPrimerLazy() {
  const carrusel = document.getElementById('carrusel_bps');
  if (!carrusel) return;
  const primerItemLi = carrusel.querySelector('li.carrusel-slide');
  if (!primerItemLi) return;
  const primeraImg = primerItemLi.querySelector('img');
  if (primeraImg) {
    if (primeraImg.hasAttribute('loading')) {
      primeraImg.removeAttribute('loading');
    }
    primeraImg.setAttribute('fetchpriority', 'high');
  }
}
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', quitarPrimerLazy);
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
  (function() {
    let isRunning = false;
    let yearTarget, monthTarget, dayTarget, hourTarget, minuteTarget, secondTarget;
    function countdownTimer(configaTime, hourId, minuteId, secondId) {
      const configArray = configaTime.split(':');
      if (!isRunning) {
        isRunning = true;
        yearTarget = parseInt(configArray[0]);
        monthTarget = parseInt(configArray[1]);
        dayTarget = parseInt(configArray[2]);
        hourTarget = parseInt(configArray[3]);
        minuteTarget = parseInt(configArray[4]);
        secondTarget = parseInt(configArray[5]);
      }
      const currentDate = new Date();
      const targetDate = new Date(yearTarget, monthTarget - 1, dayTarget, hourTarget, minuteTarget, secondTarget);
      const remainingTime = targetDate - currentDate;
      if (remainingTime <= 0) {
          document.getElementById(hourId).innerHTML = '00';
          document.getElementById(minuteId).innerHTML = '00';
          document.getElementById(secondId).innerHTML = '00';
          // hide the countdown container when it reaches 0
          // document.querySelector('.contenedor_contador').style.display = 'none';
          // document.querySelector('.contenedor_backup').style.display = 'block';
          return;
      }
      const seconds = Math.floor((remainingTime / 1000) % 60);
      const minutes = Math.floor((remainingTime / 1000 / 60) % 60);
      const hours = Math.floor((remainingTime / 1000 / 60 / 60));
      document.getElementById(hourId).innerHTML = hours < 10 ? '0' + hours : hours;
      document.getElementById(minuteId).innerHTML = minutes < 10 ? '0' + minutes : minutes;
      document.getElementById(secondId).innerHTML = seconds < 10 ? '0' + seconds : seconds;
      setTimeout(function() {
          countdownTimer(configaTime, hourId, minuteId, secondId);
      }, 1000);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
      countdownTimer("2026:11:09:07:59:59", "hourDisplay", "minuteDisplay", "secondDisplay");
    });
  })
  ();
</script>

    } = {}) {

        const POPUP_ID = "abc-custom-image-popup";
        const STORAGE_KEY = "customImagePopupShown";
        if (
            window.__abcImagePopupActive ||
            document.getElementById(POPUP_ID)
        ) {
            return;
        }

            typeof imageUrl !== "string" ||

        ) {
            return;

                        "kioskModeCookie="
                    )
                );
            if (kioskMode) {
                return;
            }
        } catch (error) {
        }

        function getSessionValue() {

            try {

                return sessionStorage.getItem(
                    STORAGE_KEY
                );

            } catch (error) {

                return null;
            }
        }

        function setSessionValue() {

            try {

                sessionStorage.setItem(
                    STORAGE_KEY,
                    "true"
                );

            } catch (error) {
            }
        }
        if (
            showOncePerSession &&
            getSessionValue()
        ) {
            return;
        }

            (
                navigator.platform === "MacIntel" &&
                navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1
            );

            (!isMobile && !showOnDesktop)
        ) {
            return;

        window.__abcImagePopupActive = true;

        if (
            typeof linkUrl === "string" &&
            linkUrl.trim() &&

            const popupLink =

        function cleanup() {

            if (isDestroyed) {
                return;
            }

            isDestroyed = true;

            clearTimeout(showTimeout);
            clearTimeout(closeTimeout);
            clearTimeout(removeTimeout);
            clearTimeout(imageTimeout);

            popupImage.onload = null;
            popupImage.onerror = null;

            document.removeEventListener(
                "keydown",
                handleEscape
            );

            popupOverlay.remove();

            window.__abcImagePopupActive = false;

        }
        function hidePopup() {

            if (
                isClosing ||
                isDestroyed ||
                !isShown
            ) {
                return;
            }

            isClosing = true;

            clearTimeout(closeTimeout);

            popupOverlay.style.opacity = "0";

            popupOverlay.style.pointerEvents =
                "none";

            popupContainer.style.transform =
                "scale(0.8)";

            removeTimeout = setTimeout(
                cleanup,
                300
            );

        }

        function showPopup() {

            if (
                isClosing ||
                isDestroyed ||
                isShown
            ) {
                return;
            }
            if (
                showOncePerSession &&
                getSessionValue()
            ) {
                cleanup();
                return;
            }
            if (!document.body) {
                cleanup();
                return;
            }
            document.body.appendChild(
                popupOverlay
            );
            isShown = true;
            popupOverlay.style.visibility =
                "visible";
            popupOverlay.style.pointerEvents =
                "auto";
            void popupOverlay.offsetWidth;
            popupOverlay.style.opacity = "1";
            popupContainer.style.transform =
                "scale(1)";
            if (showOncePerSession) {
                setSessionValue();
            }
            document.addEventListener(
                "keydown",
                handleEscape
            );
            if (closeDelay > 0) {
                closeTimeout = setTimeout(
                    hidePopup,
                    closeDelay
                );
            }
        }
        closeButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                hidePopup();
            }
        );

        popupOverlay.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function (event) {
                if (
                    event.target === popupOverlay
                ) {
                    hidePopup();
                }
            }
        );

        function handleEscape(event) {
            if (event.key === "Escape") {
                hidePopup();
            }
        }
        function handleImageLoaded() {
            if (isDestroyed) {
                return;
            }
            clearTimeout(imageTimeout);

            popupImage.onload = null;
            popupImage.onerror = null;

            showTimeout = setTimeout(
                showPopup,
                Math.max(0, showDelay)
            );
        }
        function handleImageError() {
            cleanup();
        }
        popupImage.onload =
            handleImageLoaded;

        popupImage.onerror =
            handleImageError;
        imageTimeout = setTimeout(
            function () {
                cleanup();
            },
            12000
        );
        popupImage.src = imageUrl;
        if (
            popupImage.complete &&
            popupImage.naturalWidth > 0
        ) {
            handleImageLoaded();
        }
    }
    // DATA DEL POPUP
    const popupConfig = {
        imageUrl:
            "https://www.abc.cl/on/demandware.static/-/Library-Sites-abc-shared-library/default/dw259bd2d8/abc/images/2026/noviembre/02/abc--abc_261102_home_pop-up--1_moda_moda_l_0800_v1.jpg",
        linkUrl:
            "https://www.abc.cl/moda",
        showDelay: 1000,
        //Tiempo en milisegs
        closeDelay: 8500,
        showOncePerSession: true,
        showOnDesktop: true,
        showOnMobile: true
    };
    function initializePopup() {
        showCustomImagePopup(
            popupConfig
        );
    }
    if (
        document.readyState === "loading"
    ) {
        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            initializePopup,
            { once: true }
        );
    } else {
        initializePopup();
    }
})();
</script>

<script>
  function createToasterPopup(
    url,
    imageUrl,
    triggerImageUrl,
    oncePerSession = false,
    showOnDesktop = true,
    showOnMobile = false
  ) {
    if (oncePerSession && sessionStorage.getItem("popupShown") === "true") {
      return;
    }

    const toaster = document.createElement("div");
    toaster.className = "popup-toaster";
    toaster.id = "toaster-tarjeta";

    if (!showOnDesktop) toaster.classList.add("desktop-disabled");
    if (!showOnMobile) toaster.classList.add("mobile-disabled");

    // imagen trigger
    const trigger = document.createElement("div");
    trigger.className = "popup-trigger";

    const triggerImage = document.createElement("img");
    triggerImage.src = triggerImageUrl;
    triggerImage.alt = "Abrir promoción";
    triggerImage.className = "popup-trigger-image";

    trigger.appendChild(triggerImage);

    // Toaster
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.target = "_self";
    link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";

    const image = document.createElement("img");
    image.src = imageUrl;
    image.alt = "Promoción";
    image.className = "popup-image";

    link.appendChild(image);

    // boton de cierre
    const closeButton = document.createElement("button");
    closeButton.className = "popup-close-button";
    closeButton.textContent = "Cerrar ✕";

    let isOpen = false;

    toaster.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (!isOpen) {
        event.preventDefault();
        isOpen = true;
        toaster.classList.add("open");
      }
    });

    closeButton.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      event.stopPropagation();
      toaster.remove();

      if (oncePerSession) {
        sessionStorage.setItem("popupShown", "true");
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (isOpen && !toaster.contains(event.target)) {
        toaster.remove();

        if (oncePerSession) {
          sessionStorage.setItem("popupShown", "true");
        }
      }
    });

    toaster.appendChild(trigger);
    toaster.appendChild(closeButton);
    toaster.appendChild(link);
    document.body.appendChild(toaster);
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      createToasterPopup(
        "https://www.abc.cl/solicita-tu-tarjeta.html",

        // toaster 
        "https://www.abc.cl/on/demandware.static/-/Library-Sites-abc-shared-library/default/dw9abcbec9/abc/images/2026/noviembre/04/abc--oferton_261104_home_pop-up--2_generico_generico_l_0800_v1.jpg",

        // trigger 
        "https://www.abc.cl/on/demandware.static/-/Library-Sites-abc-shared-library/default/dwb47ec207/abc/images/2026/noviembre/04/abc--oferton_261104_home_pop-up_trigger--2_generico_generico_l_0800_v1.jpg",

        false, // once per session
        true,  // show on desktop
        false  // show on mobile
      );
    }, 0);
  });
</script>

<!-- <script type="text/javascript" src="https://www.abc.cl/on/demandware.static/-/Library-Sites-abc-shared-library/es_CL/v1793977205155/js/homepage.js"></script>  --><script type="text/javascript">

// Función para desplegables del footer
function initializeFooterTabs() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".footertab").forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener("click", function () {
      tab.classList.toggle("open");
    });
  });
}
      
// Función para carruseles

function initializeCarruseles() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".carrusel").forEach((carrusel) => {
    const track = carrusel.querySelector(".carrusel-track");
    if (!track) return;

    // Clonador de slides
    const originalSlides = Array.from(track.children).map((s) => s.cloneNode(true));

    const prevButton = carrusel.querySelector(".carrusel-button-prev");
    const nextButton = carrusel.querySelector(".carrusel-button-next");
    const dotsContainer = document.createElement("div");

    dotsContainer.classList.add("carrusel-puntoss");
    carrusel.appendChild(dotsContainer);

    const config = JSON.parse(carrusel.getAttribute("data-slides-config")) || {};
    const autoplayDelay = config.autoplayDelay || 3000;
    const TRANSITION_DURATION = 300;

    let visibleSlides = config.default || 1;
    let slideBy = config.slideBy || 1;
    let currentIndex = 0;
    let autoplayIntervalId;
    let currentVisibleSlides = 0;
    let currentSlideBy = 0;

    track.style.willChange = "transform";
    track.style.touchAction = "pan-y";

    // Helper de procesamiento

    const maxIndex = () => Math.max(0, originalSlides.length - visibleSlides);

    const clampIndex = (idx) => {
      const maxIdx = maxIndex();
      return Math.min(Math.max(idx, 0), maxIdx);
    };

    const getMatrixX = (transformString) => {
      if (!transformString || transformString === "none") return 0;
      const matrixValues = transformString.match(/matrix.*\((.+)\)/);
      if (matrixValues && matrixValues[1]) {
        const parts = matrixValues[1].split(',').map(parseFloat);
        if (parts.length === 6) {
          return parts[4];
        } else if (parts.length === 16) {
          return parts[12];
        }
      }
      return 0;
    };

    // Dots

    const generateDots = () => {
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = "";
      const maxIdx = maxIndex();
      if (maxIdx === 0) {
        dotsContainer.style.display = "none";
        return;
      }

      const totalPages = Math.ceil(maxIdx / slideBy) + 1;
      if (totalPages <= 1) {
        dotsContainer.style.display = "none";
        return;
      }

      dotsContainer.style.display = "flex";
      for (let i = 0; i < totalPages; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement("button");
        dot.classList.add("carrusel-puntos");
        dot.setAttribute("aria-label", `Ir al grupo de slides ${i + 1}`);
        const targetSlideIndex = Math.min(i * slideBy, maxIdx);
        dot.setAttribute("data-slide-index", targetSlideIndex);
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    };

    const updateDots = () => {
      const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll(".carrusel-puntos");
      if (dots.length === 0) return;

      let closestPage = 0;
      let minDiff = Infinity;

      dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
        const dotSlideIndex = Number(dot.getAttribute("data-slide-index"));
        const diff = Math.abs(dotSlideIndex - currentIndex);
        if (diff < minDiff) {
          minDiff = diff;
          closestPage = i;
        }
      });

      dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
        dot.classList.toggle("active", i === closestPage);
      });
    };

    const renderCarouselStructure = () => {
      track.innerHTML = "";
      originalSlides.forEach((s) => track.appendChild(s.cloneNode(true)));

      // Forzar orden de slides de izq a der.
      track.style.display = "flex";
      track.style.flexDirection = "row";          
      track.style.flexWrap = "nowrap";            
      track.style.direction = "ltr";              
      track.style.justifyContent = "flex-start";  

      Array.from(track.children).forEach((slide) => {
        slide.style.flex = `0 0 ${100 / visibleSlides}%`;
        slide.style.order = "0";                  
        slide.style.float = "none";               
      });

      currentIndex = 0;
      applyTransform(0, false);
      generateDots();
      updateControlsVisibility();
      updateDots();
    };

    const updateControlsVisibility = () => {
      const canScroll = originalSlides.length > visibleSlides;
      const isBanner = carrusel.classList.contains("banner");
      const isDesktop = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 769px)").matches;
      const hide = !canScroll || (isBanner && isDesktop && originalSlides.length <= 6);

      if (prevButton) prevButton.style.display = hide ? "none" : "block";
      if (nextButton) nextButton.style.display = hide ? "none" : "block";
      dotsContainer.style.display =
        hide || Math.ceil(maxIndex() / slideBy) + 1 <= 1 ? "none" : "flex";
    };

    const applyTransform = (index, animate = true) => {
      currentIndex = clampIndex(index);
      const targetX = -((100 / visibleSlides) * currentIndex);

      if (animate) {
        track.style.transition = `transform ${TRANSITION_DURATION / 1000}s ease-in-out`;
        track.classList.add("is-transitioning");
      } else {
        track.style.transition = "none";
        track.classList.remove("is-transitioning");
        void track.offsetWidth;
        track.style.transition = `transform ${TRANSITION_DURATION / 1000}s ease-in-out`;
      }

      track.style.transform = `translateX(${targetX}%)`;
      updateDots();
    };

    // Manejo de dots
    const nextSlide = () => {
      if (track.classList.contains("is-transitioning")) return;
      const maxIdx = maxIndex();
      if (originalSlides.length <= visibleSlides) return;

      if (currentIndex >= maxIdx) {
        applyTransform(0);
      } else {
        applyTransform(Math.min(currentIndex + slideBy, maxIdx));
      }
    };

    const prevSlide = () => {
      if (track.classList.contains("is-transitioning")) return;
      const maxIdx = maxIndex();
      if (originalSlides.length <= visibleSlides) return;

      if (currentIndex <= 0) {
        applyTransform(maxIdx);
      } else {
        applyTransform(Math.max(0, currentIndex - slideBy));
      }
    };

    // Autoplay

    const startAutoplay = () => {
      stopAutoplay();
      const canScroll = originalSlides.length > visibleSlides;
      const isBanner = carrusel.classList.contains("banner");
      const isDesktop = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 769px)").matches;
      const skip = !canScroll || (isBanner && isDesktop && originalSlides.length <= 6);
      if (config.autoplay && !skip) {
        autoplayIntervalId = setInterval(nextSlide, autoplayDelay);
      }
    };

    const stopAutoplay = () => clearInterval(autoplayIntervalId);

    track.addEventListener("transitionend", (e) => {
      if (e.propertyName !== "transform") return;
      if (isTouchActive) return;
      track.classList.remove("is-transitioning");
      updateDots();
    });

    // Event listeners para botones

    if (prevButton) {
      prevButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        stopAutoplay();
        prevSlide();
        startAutoplay();
      });
    }

    if (nextButton) {
      nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        stopAutoplay();
        nextSlide();
        startAutoplay();
      });
    }

    // ─── Dots events ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    dotsContainer.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const dot = e.target.closest(".carrusel-puntos");
      if (!dot || track.classList.contains("is-transitioning")) return;
      stopAutoplay();
      const targetIndex = Number(dot.getAttribute("data-slide-index"));
      applyTransform(targetIndex);
      startAutoplay();
    });

    // Touch mara mobile

    let isTouchActive = false;
    let touchStartX = 0;
    let touchStartY = 0;
    let touchEndX = 0;
    let isDragging = false;
    let touchDirectionLocked = false;
    let isHorizontalScroll = false;

    track.addEventListener(
      "touchstart",
      (e) => {
        isTouchActive = true;
        stopAutoplay();

        const computedTransform = window.getComputedStyle(track).transform;
        track.style.transition = "none";
        track.classList.remove("is-transitioning");

        const parentWidth = track.parentElement ? track.parentElement.offsetWidth : 0;
        
        if (parentWidth > 0 && computedTransform && computedTransform !== "none") {
          const matrixX = getMatrixX(computedTransform);
          const slideWidthPx = parentWidth / visibleSlides;
          currentIndex = clampIndex(Math.round(-matrixX / slideWidthPx));
          const snapX = -((100 / visibleSlides) * currentIndex);
          track.style.transform = `translateX(${snapX}%)`;
        }

        void track.offsetWidth;

        touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        touchEndX = touchStartX;
        isDragging = false;
        touchDirectionLocked = false;
        isHorizontalScroll = false;
      },
      { passive: true }
    );

    track.addEventListener(
      "touchmove",
      (e) => {
        if (!e.touches.length) return;

        const deltaX = e.touches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
        const deltaY = e.touches[0].clientY - touchStartY;

        if (!touchDirectionLocked && (Math.abs(deltaX) > 5 || Math.abs(deltaY) > 5)) {
          touchDirectionLocked = true;
          isHorizontalScroll = Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY);
        }

        if (!isHorizontalScroll) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        isDragging = true;
        touchEndX = e.touches[0].clientX;

        const baseOffset = (100 / visibleSlides) * currentIndex;
        const parentWidth = track.parentElement ? track.parentElement.offsetWidth : 0;
        const dragPercent = parentWidth > 0 ? (deltaX / parentWidth) * 100 : 0;
        track.style.transform = `translateX(${-(baseOffset - dragPercent)}%)`;
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    const touchEndHandler = () => {
      if (touchStartX === 0) {
        isTouchActive = false;
        return;
      }

      const maxIdx = maxIndex();

      if (isDragging && isHorizontalScroll) {
        const swipeDistance = touchEndX - touchStartX;
        const minSwipeThreshold = 50;
        let newIndex;

        if (Math.abs(swipeDistance) < minSwipeThreshold) {
          newIndex = currentIndex;
        } else if (swipeDistance > 0) {
    // Swipe derecha 
          if (currentIndex <= 0) {
            newIndex = maxIdx;
          } else {
            newIndex = Math.max(0, currentIndex - slideBy);
          }
        } else {
    // Swipe izquierda 
          if (currentIndex >= maxIdx) {
            newIndex = 0;
          } else {
            newIndex = Math.min(currentIndex + slideBy, maxIdx);
          }
        }

        currentIndex = clampIndex(newIndex);
        const targetX = -((100 / visibleSlides) * currentIndex);

        track.style.transition = `transform ${TRANSITION_DURATION / 1000}s ease-in-out`;
        track.style.transform = `translateX(${targetX}%)`;
        track.classList.add("is-transitioning");
        updateDots();

        track.addEventListener(
          "transitionend",
          function releaseLock(ev) {
            if (ev.propertyName !== "transform") return;
            isTouchActive = false;
            track.classList.remove("is-transitioning");
            track.removeEventListener("transitionend", releaseLock);
          }
        );
      } else {
    // Sin swipe: snap a la posición actual
        const snapX = -((100 / visibleSlides) * currentIndex);
        track.style.transition = "none";
        track.style.transform = `translateX(${snapX}%)`;
        void track.offsetWidth;
        track.style.transition = `transform ${TRANSITION_DURATION / 1000}s ease-in-out`;
        isTouchActive = false;
      }

      touchStartX = 0;
      touchStartY = 0;
      touchEndX = 0;
      isDragging = false;
      touchDirectionLocked = false;
      isHorizontalScroll = false;
      startAutoplay();
    };

    track.addEventListener("touchend", touchEndHandler);
    track.addEventListener("touchcancel", touchEndHandler);

    // Pausar carruseles en hover

    carrusel.addEventListener("mouseenter", stopAutoplay);
    carrusel.addEventListener("mouseleave", startAutoplay);

    // Resize de los slides para que sea responsive

    const updateBreakpointConfig = () => {
      let newVisibleSlides = 1;
      let newSlideBy = 1;
      const width = window.innerWidth;

      if (width <= 480) {
        newVisibleSlides = config["480"] || 1;
        newSlideBy = config["slideBy480"] || 1;
      } else if (width <= 768) {
        newVisibleSlides = config["768"] || 1;
        newSlideBy = config["slideBy768"] || 1;
      } else {
        newVisibleSlides = config.default || 1;
        newSlideBy = config.slideBy || 1;
      }

      if (newVisibleSlides !== currentVisibleSlides || newSlideBy !== currentSlideBy) {
        visibleSlides = newVisibleSlides;
        slideBy = newSlideBy;
        currentVisibleSlides = newVisibleSlides;
        currentSlideBy = newSlideBy;
        renderCarouselStructure();
      }
    };

    let resizeTimeout;
    window.addEventListener(
      "resize",
      () => {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          stopAutoplay();
          updateBreakpointConfig();
          startAutoplay();
        }, 100);
      },
      { passive: true }
    );

    updateBreakpointConfig();
    startAutoplay();
  });
}


//Fin funcion carruseles

      // Función para partículas Hover (corazones)
      function initializeParticles() {
        const elements = document.querySelectorAll(".love");
        const maxParticles = 30;
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.style.position = "fixed";
        canvas.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        canvas.style.top = "0";
        canvas.style.left = "0";
        canvas.style.zIndex = "999";
        document.body.appendChild(canvas);
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      
        let particles = [];
        let animationFrameId;
      
        function createCuoreParticle(x, y) {
          return {
            x,
            y,
            size: Math.random() * 20 + 10,
            speed: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
            drift: Math.random() * 1 - 0.5,
            opacity: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.3,
          };
        }
      
        function drawCuore(x, y, size, opacity) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;
          ctx.font = `${size}px Arial`;
          ctx.fillText("💕", x, y);
          ctx.restore();
        }
      
        function updateParticles() {
          particles = particles.filter(p => {
            p.y -= p.speed;
            p.x += p.drift;
            p.opacity -= 0.002;
            return p.opacity > 0;
          });
        }
      
        function animate() {
          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          particles.forEach(p => drawCuore(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.opacity));
          updateParticles();
      
          if (particles.length > 0) {
            animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          }
        }
      
        elements.forEach(element => {
          element.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
            animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          });
      
          element.addEventListener("mousemove", (event) => {
            if (particles.length < maxParticles) {
              particles.push(createCuoreParticle(event.clientX, event.clientY));
            }
          });
      
          element.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
            particles = [];
            if (animationFrameId) {
              cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
            }
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          });
        });
      
        window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
          canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
          canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        });
      }
      
      // Function for Fade In on Show
      function initializeFadeIn() {
        const tituloElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade_in');
      
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
          entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              entry.target.classList.add('visible');
              observer.unobserve(entry.target); // Optional: animate once
            }
          });
        }, {
          root: null,
          threshold: 0.1
        });
      
        tituloElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
      }
      
      // Function for Skeleton Loading
      function initializeSkeleton() {
        const TARGET_SELECTOR = 'img, picture';
        const BATCH_SIZE = 50;
        const FALLBACK_TIMEOUT = 800;
      
        function batchAddSkeletons(elements) {
          let i = 0;
          function batch() {
            const slice = elements.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
            slice.forEach(el => el.classList.add('skeleton'));
            i += BATCH_SIZE;
            if (i < elements.length) requestAnimationFrame(batch);
          }
          batch();
        }
      
        function batchRemoveSkeletons(elements) {
          let i = 0;
          function batch() {
            const slice = elements.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
            slice.forEach(el => el.classList.remove('skeleton'));
            i += BATCH_SIZE;
            if (i < elements.length) requestAnimationFrame(batch);
          }
          batch();
        }
      
        function checkIfContentLoaded(elements) {
          return elements.every(el => {
            if (el.tagName === 'IMG') {
              return el.complete && el.naturalHeight > 0;
            }
            if (el.tagName === 'PICTURE') {
              const img = el.querySelector('img');
              return img && img.complete && img.naturalHeight > 0;
            }
            return el.textContent.trim().length > 0;
          });
        }
      
        function removeSkeletonFromTargets(elements) {
          elements.forEach(el => {
            el.classList.remove('skeleton');
            if (el.tagName === 'PICTURE') {
              const img = el.querySelector('img');
              if (img) img.classList.remove('skeleton');
            }
          });
        }
      
        function observeContentLoaded(contenedor, targets) {
          const fallbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            removeSkeletonFromTargets(targets);
            observer.disconnect();
          }, FALLBACK_TIMEOUT);
      
          const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
            if (checkIfContentLoaded(targets)) {
              clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
              observer.disconnect();
              removeSkeletonFromTargets(targets);
            }
          });
      
          observer.observe(contenedor, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            characterData: true,
            attributes: true
          });
      
          targets.forEach(el => {
            if (el.tagName === 'PICTURE') {
              const img = el.querySelector('img');
              if (img) {
                img.addEventListener('load', () => {
                  el.classList.remove('skeleton');
                  img.classList.remove('skeleton');
                  if (checkIfContentLoaded(targets)) {
                    clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
                    observer.disconnect();
                  }
                }, { once: true });
      
                img.addEventListener('error', () => {
                  clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
                  observer.disconnect();
                  removeSkeletonFromTargets(targets);
                }, { once: true });
              }
            } else if (el.tagName === 'IMG') {
              el.addEventListener('load', () => {
                el.classList.remove('skeleton');
                const picture = el.closest('picture');
                if (picture) picture.classList.remove('skeleton');
                if (checkIfContentLoaded(targets)) {
                  clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
                  observer.disconnect();
                }
              }, { once: true });
      
              el.addEventListener('error', () => {
                clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
                observer.disconnect();
                removeSkeletonFromTargets(targets);
              }, { once: true });
            }
          });
        }
      
        function processContenedor(contenedor) {
          const targets = Array.from(contenedor.querySelectorAll(TARGET_SELECTOR));
          if (targets.length === 0) return;
      
          batchAddSkeletons(targets);
          observeContentLoaded(contenedor, targets);
        }
        function initObserver() {
          const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                processContenedor(entry.target);
                observer.unobserve(entry.target);
              }
            });
          }, {
            rootMargin: '100px',
            threshold: 0.1
          });
      
         // Get all .contenedor elements inside #carrusel_bps
        const excluded = new Set(
          Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#carrusel_bps .contenedor'))
        );
      
        // Skip all .contenedor elements with [data-no-skeleton]
        document.querySelectorAll('.contenedor').forEach(el => {
          if (!el.hasAttribute('data-no-skeleton')) {
            io.observe(el);
          }
        });
      }
      
        if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
          requestIdleCallback(initObserver);
        } else {
          window.addEventListener('load', initObserver);
        }
      }
      
      
      // Iniciar scripts que necesitan el contenido del DOM cargado
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        initializeFooterTabs();
        initializeParticles();
        initializeFadeIn();
      });
      
      // Iniciar scripts que se disparan inmediatamente
      initializeCarruseles();
      initializeSkeleton();

      //QUITAR LAZY LOADING
      function removeLazyLoadingFromFirstImage() {
  const carrusel = document.getElementById('carrusel_bps');
  if (!carrusel) return;

  const firstListItem = carrusel.querySelector('li.carrusel-slide');
  if (!firstListItem) return;

  const firstImage = firstListItem.querySelector('img');
  if (firstImage && firstImage.hasAttribute('loading')) {
    firstImage.removeAttribute('loading');
  }
}

function waitForCarrusel() {
  const maxAttempts = 10;
  let attempts = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    const carrusel = document.getElementById('carrusel_bps');
    attempts++;
    if (carrusel) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      removeLazyLoadingFromFirstImage();
    } else if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
      clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, 500);
}

        closeMenu();

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('.sideslider.row');

  sliders.forEach(slider => {
    const wrapper = slider.closest('.sideslider-wrapper') || slider.parentElement;
    const prevBtn = wrapper.querySelector('.carrusel-button-prev');
    const nextBtn = wrapper.querySelector('.carrusel-button-next');

    // Obtenemos los elementos de la barra personalizada
    const scrollbarContainer = wrapper.querySelector('.sideslider-scrollbar-container');
    const scrollbarThumb = wrapper.querySelector('.sideslider-scrollbar-thumb');

    let isDown = false;
    let startX;
    let scrollLeftStart;
    let isDragging = false;
    let thumbWidthPercent = 0; // Almacenamos el porcentaje del ancho para optimizar cálculos

    // --- 1. DETECCIÓN DINÁMICA DE DESBORDAMIENTO (OVERFLOW) ---
    const checkOverflow = () => {
      const hasOverflow = slider.scrollWidth > slider.clientWidth + 2;

      if (!hasOverflow) {
        if (prevBtn) prevBtn.classList.add('hide');
        if (nextBtn) nextBtn.classList.add('hide');
        if (scrollbarContainer) scrollbarContainer.style.display = 'none';
        slider.style.cursor = 'default';
        slider.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
        slider.dataset.needScroll = "false";
      } else {
        slider.style.cursor = 'grab';
        slider.style.overflowX = 'auto';
        slider.dataset.needScroll = "true";

        if (scrollbarContainer) {
          scrollbarContainer.style.display = 'block';
          // Calculamos el ancho proporcional que debe tener el tirador (mínimo 15%)
          const visibleRatio = slider.clientWidth / slider.scrollWidth;
          thumbWidthPercent = Math.max(visibleRatio * 100, 15);
          if (scrollbarThumb) {
            scrollbarThumb.style.width = `${thumbWidthPercent}%`;
          }
        }
        updateUI();
      }
    };

    // --- 2. ACTUALIZACIÓN DE BOTONES Y DESPLAZAMIENTO DEL THUMB ---
    const updateUI = () => {
      if (slider.dataset.needScroll === "false") return;

      const scrollLeft = slider.scrollLeft;
      const maxScrollLeft = slider.scrollWidth - slider.clientWidth;

      // 2a. Desplazar el "thumb" personalizado (Alto Rendimiento)
      if (scrollbarThumb && maxScrollLeft > 0) {
        const scrollRatio = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
        // Fórmula matemática exacta para trasladar el elemento sobre su propio eje en %
        const translatePercent = scrollRatio * ((100 / thumbWidthPercent) - 1) * 100;
        scrollbarThumb.style.transform = `translateX(${translatePercent}%)`;
      }

      // 2b. Visibilidad de los botones de navegación
      if (prevBtn && nextBtn) {
        if (scrollLeft <= 1) {
          prevBtn.classList.add('hide');
        } else {
          prevBtn.classList.remove('hide');
        }

        if (scrollLeft >= maxScrollLeft - 1.5) {
          nextBtn.classList.add('hide');
        } else {
          nextBtn.classList.remove('hide');
        }
      }
    };

    // --- 3. EVENTOS DE CLIC EN LOS BOTONES ---
    if (prevBtn) {
      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (slider.dataset.needScroll === "false") return;
        slider.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        slider.scrollLeft -= slider.clientWidth * 0.75;
      });
    }

    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (slider.dataset.needScroll === "false") return;
        slider.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        slider.scrollLeft += slider.clientWidth * 0.75;
      });
    }

    // --- 4. EVENTOS DE ARRASTRE DIRECTO EN EL CARRUSEL (DRAG-TO-SCROLL) ---
    slider.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
    });

    slider.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      if (slider.dataset.needScroll === "false") return;
      isDown = true;
      slider.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      slider.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto'; // Desactiva scroll suave nativo durante drag manual
      startX = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeftStart = slider.scrollLeft;
      isDragging = false;
    });

    slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      isDown = false;
      slider.style.cursor = 'grab';
    });

    slider.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      isDown = false;
      slider.style.cursor = 'grab';
    });

    slider.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDown || slider.dataset.needScroll === "false") return;
      e.preventDefault(); 
      const x = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
      const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5; 
      if (Math.abs(walk) > 5) {
        isDragging = true;
      }
      slider.scrollLeft = scrollLeftStart - walk;
    });

    slider.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (isDragging) {
        e.preventDefault();
        isDragging = false;
      }
    });

    // --- 4b. NUEVO: EVENTOS DE ARRASTRE Y CLIC DE LA BARRA DE DESPLAZAMIENTO ---
    let isThumbDown = false;
    let thumbStartX;
    let thumbScrollLeftStart;

    if (scrollbarThumb && scrollbarContainer) {
      scrollbarThumb.style.cursor = 'grab';

      // Función que calcula y ejecuta el scroll según la posición del mouse
      const onThumbMouseMove = (e) => {
        if (!isThumbDown) return;
        const deltaX = e.pageX - thumbStartX;
        const containerWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
        const thumbWidth = scrollbarThumb.clientWidth;
        const maxThumbTravel = containerWidth - thumbWidth;
        const maxSliderScroll = slider.scrollWidth - slider.clientWidth;

        if (maxThumbTravel > 0) {
          const scrollRatio = maxSliderScroll / maxThumbTravel;
          slider.scrollLeft = thumbScrollLeftStart + (deltaX * scrollRatio);
        }
      };

      // Desvinculación de eventos globales al soltar el clic
      const onThumbMouseUp = () => {
        isThumbDown = false;
        scrollbarThumb.style.cursor = 'grab';
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onThumbMouseMove);
        window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onThumbMouseUp);
      };

      scrollbarThumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if (slider.dataset.needScroll === "false") return;
        isThumbDown = true;
        scrollbarThumb.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
        slider.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto'; // Movimiento reactivo e inmediato
        thumbStartX = e.pageX;
        thumbScrollLeftStart = slider.scrollLeft;
        document.body.style.userSelect = 'none'; // Evitar seleccionar contenido de la web

        // Vinculamos temporalmente eventos a window para no perder el foco si el mouse sale rápido del thumb
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', onThumbMouseMove);
        window.addEventListener('mouseup', onThumbMouseUp);

        e.stopPropagation(); // Evita accionar el mousedown del slider contenedor
        e.preventDefault();
      });
    }

    // Permitir clic en la barra para "saltar" directo a esa posición
    if (scrollbarContainer) {
      scrollbarContainer.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === scrollbarThumb) return; // Si es el tirador original, ignoramos el clic
        if (slider.dataset.needScroll === "false") return;

        const rect = scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const thumbWidth = scrollbarThumb.clientWidth;
        const maxThumbTravel = rect.width - thumbWidth;

        if (maxThumbTravel > 0) {
          // Centramos el thumb donde se hizo el clic
          const targetThumbLeft = clickX - (thumbWidth / 2);
          const clampedLeft = Math.max(0, Math.min(targetThumbLeft, maxThumbTravel));
          const maxSliderScroll = slider.scrollWidth - slider.clientWidth;
          const scrollRatio = maxSliderScroll / maxThumbTravel;

          slider.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth'; // Desplazamiento estético en clics directos
          slider.scrollLeft = clampedLeft * scrollRatio;
        }
      });
    }

    // --- 5. ESCUCHAS DE ESTADO ---
    slider.addEventListener('scroll', updateUI);
    window.addEventListener('resize', checkOverflow);

    // Asegurar cálculo correcto tras la renderización de imágenes lazy-load
    slider.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img => {
      img.addEventListener('load', checkOverflow);
    });

    // Carga Inicial
    checkOverflow();
    window.addEventListener('load', checkOverflow);
  });
});
</script>

function insertPickupDisclaimer() {
    const variationAttributes = document.querySelector('.variation-attribute');

    if (!variationAttributes) return;

    // Check for color and/or size variations
    const hasVariations = variationAttributes.querySelector(
        '.variation-attribute .attribute .color, ' +
        '.variation-attribute .attribute .size-variation'
    );

    // Prevent duplicate disclaimers
    if (!hasVariations || document.querySelector('.pickup-disclaimer')) return;

    const disclaimer = document.createElement('div');
    disclaimer.className = 'pickup-disclaimer';
    disclaimer.textContent =
        'Selecciona talla y/o color para ver las opciones de despacho y retiro';

    variationAttributes.before(disclaimer);
}
